protocol_metadata.about: SoSoValue Indexes (SSI) is a spot crypto index protocol built on the Base EVM chain that allows users to mint and redeem wrapped index tokens representing diversified baskets of crypto assets spanning multiple chains (BTC, ETH, SOL, etc.). The protocol packages multi-chain, multi-asset portfolios into on-chain tokens such as MAG7.ssi, DEFI.ssi, MEME.ssi, and USSI, which rebalance monthly. Underlying spot assets are held with licensed institutional custodians (Cobo); mint/burn/rebalance operations are governed by on-chain issuer, rebalancer, and factory contracts with a protocol owner address labeled as Cobo custody.
